headline: Continued revisions to Ends Policy and Executive Limitation 2.4 to September 2; approved three hires and Dan Boyer for Act 170 committee.
summary: The board discussed a first draft of the Ends Policy update, with a second reading to follow. It also discussed Executive Limitation 2.4, where the superintendent recommended raising a bidding limit from $25,000 to $40,000. The consent agenda approved three staff hires, and Dan Boyer was nominated for the Act 170 Merger Committee.
decisions: Continued the Ends Policy update to a second reading on September 2, set as a community forum.
Continued Revised Executive Limitation 2.4 Financial Condition and Activities to a second reading on September 2.
Approved the consent agenda, including three one-year hires: Katherine Lafont, Rebecca Mellen, and Megan Ozog.
Approved the nomination of Dan Boyer as the second board member for the Act 170 Merger Committee.

decision_evidence.quote: Add the following items to the September 2 agenda: 1.) Ends Policy update (second reading) set as a community forum; 2.) Revised Executive Limitation 2.4 Financial Condition and Activities (second reading).

Add the following items to the September 2 agenda: 1.) Ends Policy update (second reading) set as a community forum; 2.) Revised Executive Limitation 2.4 Financial Condition and Activities (second reading).
Seamus Abshere asked if there were any objections to the Consent Agenda. Hearing none. Agenda is passed by consent.

Seamus Abshere entertained a motion to nominate Dan Boyer to be the second board member for the Act 170 Merger Committee. Tom Chittenden moves, Elissa Galvez seconds. No discussion. All in favor and motion passes.
